# Coordinate

## Summary
Base-realm x/y coordinate pair. Lives at
`https://cardstack.com/base/coordinate` (default export `CoordinateField`).

## API
- `x`, `y` — NumberFields

## Usage
```ts
import CoordinateField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/coordinate';

@field position = contains(CoordinateField);
```
General-purpose plane coordinates (chart points, canvas positions, grid
cells). For geographic latitude/longitude prefer the catalog geo-point
field, which carries map-aware components.
